name: Alaska Airlines Visa Signature® Credit Card

lostBaggage.notes: Bank of America Visa Signature cardholders have some basic lost luggage protections. Verify current coverage terms at application.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel accident insurance up to $1,000,000 for accidental death or dismemberment when purchasing airline tickets with the card. Visa Signature benefit.

emergencyMedical.notes: Emergency assistance services available through Visa. No dedicated medical evacuation coverage.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto rental collision damage waiver. Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first.

purchaseProtection.notes: Verify current purchase protection terms. Some standard Bank of America Visa Signature protections may apply.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extended warranty protection may be included as a Visa Signature benefit.

pointValue.transferPartners: Alaska Airlines Mileage Plan — transfer partners include American Airlines, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, Emirates, Finnair, Japan Airlines, and others

annualCredits.name: Companion Fare
annualCredits.notes: Annual companion fare from $122 ($99 base fare + taxes/fees from $23) each account anniversary — companion flies on the same Alaska Airlines itinerary. One of the most valuable airline card benefits available.

freeCheckedBags.notes: First checked bag free for cardholder and up to 6 companions on the same reservation when flying Alaska Airlines. Saves $30 per person each way.

priorityBoarding.notes: Board in Group C (before general boarding) on Alaska Airlines flights.

eliteStatusBenefits.mvpBonus: 3,000 bonus miles after each Alaska Airlines flight when you spend $1+ on the card.
eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Card does not directly confer MVP status. Miles earned through spending count toward MVP qualifying miles.

oneWorldBenefits.notes: Alaska Mileage Plan miles can be redeemed on oneworld partner airlines (American Airlines, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, Japan Airlines, Qantas, etc.) — one of the most flexible mileage programs.

companionFare.notes: Anniversary companion fare valid on Alaska Airlines main cabin and first class tickets. Must purchase original ticket with card.

travelPerks: First checked bag free (cardholder + up to 6 companions)

Access to Alaska Mileage Plan's world-class partner redemptions

bestFor: Alaska Airlines flyers who value the annual companion fare and one of the most flexible airline mile programs
